text:
Sanjay Rao: FYI handoff — ACMECloud wants an on-prem reference architecture + Terraform module that wires Redwood Private into their appliance catalog. Need eng + infra review before we publish to partner docs.

Anna Patel: Got it. Do we have a preferred network topology? VPC-like overlay or plain L2 peering for their appliance?

Sanjay Rao: They requested minimal L3 changes — prefer a routed overlay (BGP from appliance to customer fabric). We should include example calico/metalLB hints and a KMS integration example (HSM support).

Mike Chen: I can draft the Terraform module for the infra pieces. Plan: module exposes variables for subnet IDs, KMS key ARN, node pools, and an optional `hsm_endpoint`. Will include outputs for `rwd_private_endpoint` and `lb_ips`.

Julia Gomez: For security review: make sure the module has IAM roles scoped to least privilege and an option to disable public egress. Also add a snippet showing how to enable TLS between Redwood control plane and on-prem runtime with cert rotation notes.

Tom W.: Re: cert rotation — we'll point them at our `cert-rotator` sidecar. Example config: ```yaml
rwd_control:
  endpoint: "https://rwd.example.local"
  tls:
    mode: mTLS
    ca: /etc/rwd/ca.pem
    rotate_every: 720h
```

Mike Chen: Draft Terraform snippet for module usage (will include in refarch docs): ```hcl
module "rwd_onprem" {
  source = "git::https://github.com/redwood-inference/partner-modules.git//onprem-rwd?ref=v0.1.0"
  subnet_ids = var.subnet_ids
  kms_key_arn = var.kms_key_arn
  hsm_endpoint = var.hsm_endpoint
  enable_public_egress = false
}
```

Sanjay Rao: Perfect. Also add a short appendix with troubleshooting tips for common failures (KV cache warmup, disk IO throttling on appliances, and GPU driver mismatches).

Anna Patel: I'll add the appendix and a small perf table showing target latencies for G5 vs A100 appliances at different batch sizes. Quick question: do we name the templates under `marketplace/onprem/` or `refarch/onprem/`? Marketplace team prefers the former for discoverability.

marketplace-bot: Note created — draft artifact placed at https://partners.redwood.dev/onprem-drafts/ACMECloud-refarch-v0.1 (private repo). :white_check_mark:

Julia Gomez: One more: include guidance for audit logs — show how to forward runtime logs to customer SIEM using syslog or a fluentd example. Small snippet: ```yaml
fluentd:
  outputs:
    - type: syslog
      endpoint: "siem.acme.local:514"
```

Tom W.: I'll run a smoke test for the module on our lab rack next week, will post the results here.

Sanjay Rao: Great — target to have internal review complete by EOD Friday. If anyone hits blockers ping me or @eng-runtime. Thanks all :rocket:
